label: copy phase of long sequences at absolute steps 10-12 and 16-17
explanation: Copy-phase-only reset-gate unit: it never fires during the original phase and essentially never at the <DEL> step. Within the copy phase it is governed by absolute time and sequence length. Rate peaks at t=10-12 (recall_idx 1-3 for L=8-9) and again at t=16-17 (last outputs of L=9), and it rises steeply with L (L=9 holds 62% of the mass; L<=5 almost none). The strongest activations come from 2nd-3rd copy outputs of L=9 sequences that start with u and whose second token is w/s/b. Token identity (in_tok w,b,s,d,a,m; out_tok b,d,a,m) modulates rate about 2-4x, but adding token sets lowered F1, so they are left out of the predicate. Precision is low (~0.34): many matching steps stay below threshold, and the token dependence is fuzzy. Dev F1 0.46, mass recall 0.78.
